info.title: RetailPilot AI API
info.description: AI replenishment platform for multi-store FMCG retail.

get.description: Returns stores visible to the user: Super Admin sees all stores; Store Supervisor sees own store only.
Returns the latest successful nightly run for 'Data as of last run'.

post.description: Triggers the nightly replenishment pipeline manually (Super Admin only).

get.description: Returns aggregated executive/store dashboard KPIs. Store supervisor is scoped to own store.
Series and breakdowns behind the dashboard widgets (D-46). Store supervisors are scoped to their store.
Classification, category performance, forecast mix and top lost sales (D-48). Supervisors: own store.
Lists inbox recommendations with bounded offset pagination and rank sorting.
Returns single recommendation detail with viewer-scoped evidence.

post.description: Accepts, rejects, or edits a recommendation.

get.description: Lists purchase orders with lines scoped per viewer role.
Returns single purchase order detail with viewer scoping.

post.description: Super Admin resolves a NEEDS_REVIEW purchase order.
Receives goods delivery against a submitted purchase order (SD-16).
Super Admin closes short an undelivered balance on a PO.
Decides line-level L1 or PO-level L2 purchase order approval (SD-10).

get.description: Lists stock transfers for the store or chain with paging.
Returns single transfer order detail with viewer scoping.

post.description: Destination store supervisor accepts the incoming transfer (SD-12 step 1).
Donor store supervisor approves releasing stock (SD-12 step 2).
Destination or donor supervisor rejects the transfer.
Donor store supervisor marks the stock as dispatched (SD-12 step 4).
Destination store supervisor confirms receipt quantity (SD-12 step 5).

get.description: Store inventory grid with stockout risk rank sort and summary totals (SD-15).
Movement ledger, newest first (occurred_at DESC, movement_id DESC), keyset-paged (D-37).
Returns store batches in FEFO order with expiry risk.
Returns store batches expiring within N days.
Returns in-app notifications for the current user or store.

post.description: Marks an in-app notification as read.

get.description: The editable global business rules with their current values (spec §9).

put.description: Change one global rule (validated by type and range). Takes effect at the next nightly run.

patch.description: Global "All LLM agents" switch (cost and safety kill switch). Applies from the next run.
Turn an agent on or off (reason required, audited, versioned). Applies from the NEXT run.

get.description: What a "Run now" would do: upstream reuse / re-run, downstream re-runs, supersession, blocks.

post.description:
Run now. DRY_RUN (default) stores outputs in a preview set only; LIVE publishes like a nightly stage and
needs a reason and confirmation. Runs in the background; poll GET /agent-runs/{run_id}.

get.description: Agent runs, newest first (keyset paging).
Run trace: steps (tool calls, LLM calls, child runs, errors, stop reason), previews of a dry run.

post.description: Request cancellation of a RUNNING root run; it stops after the current step.

get.description: Acceptance per agent and decision type (live decisions only) — feeds the Objective III evaluation.
Root runs (nightly and manual triggers) with their stages in order.
Visual flow of one run: agents, key tools and human approval gates (fixed layout).

post.description:
Answer a question from recommendations, evidence, business rules and policies — with citations. The agent
only reads; asking it to approve, submit or change anything is refused (409 when the agent is disabled).

TransferEvidence.title: TransferEvidence
TransferEvidence.description:
TRANSFER (surplus or expiry-aware) — design doc §6.

Scoped per viewer (D-32): donor_surplus and donor_protected_requirement describe the DONOR store's stock, so
they are filled for the Super Admin and for the donor store's own supervisor, and null for the destination
supervisor (CLAUDE.md rule 10), who sees the donor as name + offered qty plus the numberless assurance
`donor_keeps_requirement`.

transfer_cost.title: Transfer Cost
